title: From catalogue to catalyst spread

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Make a strategic change explicit, because a visual identity needs a clear account of what the organization wants to become.
strategic_value: Pairing the Museum’s shift with expanding words can connect the circular graphic system to its advocacy ambition.
demonstration: An open book places From catalogue to catalyst on a pale left page and concentric colored word rings around a symbol on the dark right page.
practical_value: Compare a concise strategic statement with the graphic behavior chosen to express it.

content_islands.name: Strategic statement
content_islands.spec: Set the large stacked phrase centrally on the pale left page beneath the museum name.

content_islands.name: Word-ring field
content_islands.spec: Fill the right page with colored circular words surrounding the radial symbol.

content_islands.name: Book form
content_islands.spec: Retain the gutter and page edges so the spread reads as a publication.

reference_purposes.Expression: An open book places From catalogue to catalyst on a pale left page and concentric colored word rings around a symbol on the dark right page.
reference_purposes.Intent: The printed phrase From catalogue to catalyst states the shift; accompanying Pentagram prose explains the aim of turning audiences into advocates for the planet.
